purpose: Define the minimum path from source-status signal to current-status candidate.

protocol_steps.name: locate_case_identity
protocol_steps.output: case caption, court, docket number if available, source document used

protocol_steps.name: accession_terminal_or_latest_order
protocol_steps.output: official docket/order URL or accession receipt, content hash where lawful/appropriate

protocol_steps.name: separate_order_type
protocol_steps.output: motion, order, dismissal, partial termination, full termination, sustainment, modification, appeal/reversal

protocol_steps.name: compare_carriers
protocol_steps.output: cases-page label vs press release vs order vs monitor/local page

protocol_steps.name: create_status_candidate
protocol_steps.output: candidate with evidence refs, timestamp, uncertainty, and rollback trigger

protocol_steps.name: display_gate_review
protocol_steps.output: public wording that preserves history and avoids person extraction

current_status_gate.reason: Status candidates and order accession queue exist, but no terminal order/docket accession was performed.

hard_stops: No PACER-only inaccessible status claim without citation path.
No public current-status display from press release alone.
No person extraction while checking docket.
